posts.body_html: I just received my plants from Calen. They were held hostage by USPS for unknown reasons, and were delivered exactly one week late. However, Calen packed them so well, they couldn't have been in better shape! They are dormant now so I'll have to take pictures of them in the spring. I got S. alata "Night," Reptilian Rose, and rosea f. lutea. Two freebies as well! These were S. leucophylla and S. Hot Lips x Legacy. I'm over the moon to recieve these plants - thank you!!!
